en.headline: Hong Kong Heritage Museum holds free Fun Day in Sha Tin today
en.dek: The museum offers interactive activities, workshops and a free screening of a restored 1959 Cantonese opera film from 10am to 6:30pm with no advance booking required.
body: The Hong Kong Heritage Museum is holding a Fun Day today as part of the Hong Kong Museum Festival 2026. The event runs from 10am to 6:30pm at 1 Man Lam Road, Sha Tin, with free admission and no registration needed for walk-in participation.

Programmes include a full-day colour hunt across the galleries, afternoon interactive challenges in the ground-floor lobby, a 3D museum workshop on the second floor, and a free screening of the restored 1959 Cantonese opera film Butterfly and Red Pear Blossom at 3pm in the first-floor theatre. Seating for the film is first-come, first-served.

The Leisure and Cultural Services Department said the activities are designed to let visitors explore the museum’s exhibitions through different formats. The museum is a short walk from Che Kung Temple MTR station.

zh.headline: 香港文化博物館今日沙田舉行免費同樂日
zh.dek: 館方上午10時至下午6時30分提供互動活動、工作坊及免費放映1959年修復版粵劇電影，毋須預先報名。
body: 香港文化博物館今日舉辦同樂日，作為「香港博物館節2026」活動之一。活動於沙田文林路1號舉行，時間由上午10時至下午6時30分，免費入場，毋須預先報名，歡迎即場參加。
節目包括全日各展廳的色彩尋寶遊、下午地下大堂的互動挑戰、二樓立體博物館工作坊，以及下午3時於一樓劇院免費放映1959年修復版粵劇電影《蝶影紅梨記》。放映名額有限，先到先得。
康樂及文化事務署表示，活動讓市民以不同方式探索博物館展覽。博物館距離港鐵車公廟站步行約數分鐘。
